# Fabrizzio Ruiz

> Fabrizzio Ruiz is a senior graphic, web and 3D designer based in Asunción, Paraguay, with more than eight years of experience. He was Lead Designer for graphic and web work at Tenth Element in Las Vegas, Nevada, from 2020 to 2022, and has worked remotely as a freelancer since 2018. He offers white-label design for agencies, branding, trade show booth design, and 3D/AR visualization, and works hours that overlap US time zones.

Spanish pages are published at the unprefixed URLs. The same pages are also published in English under /en/. There is no separate Portuguese URL.

## Contact

## Location

The website, contact card and about page say Asunción, Paraguay. Do not replace that with another city.

## Projects

- [Indufar · El Delta](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/el-delta/): Design and visualization for a built brand space with a nutrition bar, a photo opportunity and an activation — shown as 3D renders next to photographs of the realized space.
- [Indufar Run](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/indufar-run/): Spatial design for TG, Banes, Mentovick, Vitamina C, Arsetonic and Indufar — a family of booths for tasting, product display and interaction.
- [Foody · ExpoVet](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/foody/): From concept to a 3 × 3 m exhibition stand: brand graphics, a product display, a prize wheel and a flyer with a QR code to the product catalog.
- [Indufar · Casa Albirroja](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/casa-albirroja/): From the Somos el Aguante campaign artwork to a stand with its own football table.
- [Indufar 2026](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/indufar-2026/): Race graphics, stage screens and exhibition stands for Indufar Run and the brand’s 2026 activations.
- [Gestecner · Navegestic](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/gestecner/): Two booth concepts for Boat Port Show 2026, built around an aerial drone, an aquatic drone and an isometric map that continues from the wall to the floor.
- [Ruiseñor](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/ruisenor/): Website design proposal for a peanut and nut brand, with a product catalog, size selector and animated packaging.
- [Kamelio](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/kamelio/): Chameleon identity with concept mockups for vehicle graphics and stationery.
- [ADM · Human Rights Policy Implementation](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/adm-human-rights-report/): A 30-slide presentation of ADM’s 2022 human rights report, with supply-chain maps, performance indicators and community programs.
- [ACUO · Social media](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/acuo-redes/): Campaign artwork, infographics, interviews and reels from the ACUO social archive.
- [Gio Mobili](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/gio-mobili/): The Gio Mobili identity across its showroom, entrance, brochure and product tags.
- [ReCELLebrate](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/recellebrate/): Social campaign series, email graphics and mobile layouts for ReCELLebrate.
- [Bar de Cejas](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/bar-de-cejas/): A 3D walkthrough of the brow bar shows how the counters and workstations fit into its footprint.
- [Black Sail](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/black-sail/): The sailboat mark on a reception wall and in a new corporate stationery mockup.
- [Vegas Valley SAR](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/vegas-valley/): Two badge designs and a concept mockup of the mountain emblem embroidered on a field bag.
- [Mosconi](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/mosconi/): Social media grids for events and promotions, and a vertical cocktail story.
- [Pam Paiva](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/pam-paiva/): A five-part social series for a self-makeup course.
- [PWR × Patagonia · Abrazo de Oso](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/abrazo-de-oso/): Selected slides from the PWR campaign presentation for Patagonia, including the activation and retail display.
- [IDEM Agromarketing](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/idem/): Presentation design for an agricultural marketing agency, from the opening slide to its service infographic.
- [Bad Liar](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/bad-liar/): The full Bad Liar website design, from the opening artwork to the cocktail recipes, contact form and footer.
- [Protein Bar](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/protein-bar/): Social posts for Protein Bar’s smoothies, cold-pressed juices and café, alongside its printed delivery piece.
- [ACUO · Cosmic](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/acuo/): A vertical video presenting the Cosmic website on a mobile screen.
- [Skylinq Home](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/skylinq/): Website design for home energy and improvement services.
- [Social Media Assets](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/social-media-assets/): Campaign visuals made to communicate a client's content.
- [Slides & Pitch Decks](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/pitch-decks/): A multinational brand report prepared to brand guidelines.
- [Client Logos](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/client-logos/): A selection of logo design work.
- [ArchViz & Retail Design](https://fabrizzioruiz.com/en/work/architectural-visualization/): Architectural and retail design visuals from selected projects.
